kv_memory.formula: 2 (K and V) * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * context_tokens * concurrent_sequences * 2 (f16 bytes)

runtime_constraints: Use a current llama.cpp build with support for the selected architecture and quantization. Runtime support was documented, not benchmarked or execution-tested in this research.
GGUF file bytes are storage bytes, not measured resident VRAM/RAM. Graph buffers, padding, backend allocations, driver/OS memory, memory mapping and offload policy can change actual requirements.
4096 tokens means total cached context (prompt plus generated tokens), one concurrent sequence, f16 keys and values. This does not specify throughput-oriented prompt token batching.

The official model card provides llama.cpp GGUF usage. The 4096-token cost scenario is deliberately shorter than the model card's recommended output budgets for complex reasoning; no quality equivalence is claimed.

price_provenance.method: Append-preserving union of dated reviewed snapshots; no interpolation or replacement of older observations.

snapshots.method: Manual review of web.run open/find seller-page text. This is a retrieval timestamp, not a guaranteed live HTTP quotation. Only sources reporting 'Crawled: today' are included in current offers.

limitations: A bounded reference set, not an exhaustive Japanese market scan and not a claim of nationwide lowest price.
GPU offers cover the card only. Host PC, CPU, motherboard, RAM, SSD, case, cooling and adequate PSU are excluded.
Computer offers cover the computer configuration, excluding monitor, keyboard, mouse, paid software and warranty upgrades.
Memory GiB values follow marketed RAM/VRAM capacities as modeling inputs; runtime/backend labels are compatibility assumptions, not benchmarks.
Eight GiB computer OS/application reserve is an explicit conservative modeling assumption, not a measured allocation limit. GPU zero reserve is not a promise all VRAM is usable.
Power use and token throughput are not provided by these price observations and must not be invented.
Current observed_at is the web-tool retrieval time. Crawled-today metadata is preserved, but checkout-level live quotes and inventory are not verified.
available means a purchase listing is explicitly orderable, not necessarily ready stock. Always show availability and lead_time_weeks; made-to-order rows are not immediate-delivery offers.
Do not use unavailable or unknown-availability rows to compute confirmed purchase minima. RTX 3090 and RTX 5090 had no confirmed purchasable seller listing in this bounded fresh-page subset.

The sole historical series is Kakaku's dated minimum for one exact Palit SKU, not a GPU-family index. Keep it separate from seller-direct snapshots and do not interpolate missing dates or splice sources invisibly.
Points, coupons, rebates and financing are ignored. Shipping zero refers to displayed ordinary domestic delivery and can have region/payment exceptions.
No recurring collection has been configured; future points require fresh verifiable observations.
